create_vector_store_dataset: create a RAGFlow dataset via the transform_create_vector_store_request method with name and optional metadata fields
build_ragflow_api_url: build the complete RAGFlow API URL from api_base, litellm_params, or environment variables
validate_ragflow_environment: validate the RAGFlow environment by checking for RAGFLOW_API_KEY and setting required HTTP headers
get_ragflow_auth_credentials: get RAGFlow authentication credentials as Bearer token headers from litellm_params or env var
transform_ragflow_response: transform a RAGFlow HTTP response into a VectorStoreCreateResponse with dataset id and metadata
